details: Developed a data-driven full-stack application using Python, Django, PostgreSQL, TimeScaleDB, and Redis.
Designed REST APIs and database-backed workflows for financial time-series data and ML predictions.
Integrated Upstox API for real-time stock data and trading functionalities.
Trained, evaluated and compared multiple ML and DL models for short-term price movement forecasts.
Built a computer vision-based attendance system with a Flutter Android client and Flask backend.
Used DeepFace and OpenCV for face detection and recognition, with MySQL for data storage.
Optimized image preprocessing and face recognition pipeline for low-latency real-time execution.
